nom: MAREE Exfoliating Toner with Salicylic Acid

avis.texte: This product is EVERYYYYTHING!!! I've been using this for about a week now and I can feel a difference. My skin is soft and glowing. I'am a dark skinned 59 years young woman and this product loves on my skin. It is gentle to my skin.I use this product everyday. And I follow it up with a collagen moisturizer. I love this exfoliating toner. I will recommend this product to friends and family. Thanks MAREE!!!!

I got this because I normally use 2% salicylic acid to keep my breakouts under control. This toner has a combination of other types of acids along with the salicylic - maybe the percentage of salicylic is too reduced by the others? I have been using it on the 'T' zone on my face but it doesn't seem to be doing as effective a job at keeping my breakouts at bay. While I like the product, I don't think I'll be buying this again.
I have been using this every night but I am not sure if I have noticed any differences.

I can see a difference in my face where i had skin discoloration on my cheeks or sun damage... Really not sure what it is. Ive only been using it for almost a week and i see where its getting clearer. Im hoping that if i use it a little longer, itll be gone or hardly noticeable.

avis.titre: Great price point for porn cleaning power
avis.texte: Ive used alil over half the bottle thus far and I think that this is a good daily toner, I dont find the actives to be too strong. (Not necessarily bad or good. Just depends on YOUR skins needs). There may very minimal amounts of actives in the product, since cleverly most beauty products do not give an amount. I use The Ordinary 2% salicylic acid serum (One of THE best affordable brands out there, for real actives, transparent ingredient lists, and at well below bigger brand names price points) after washing, and toning every other day to keep my pores unclogs. But I was using another toner that ran out, which had glycolic acid in it and the combo was great for my basic routine, I was hoping to find something similar in price point and result. I think this is a bit weaker for my needs, but I have had no breakouts from it, I DO think it works, and would work great for someone with more sensitive skin then my own. I will continue using the bottle I have, and I would consider using it again since I know what to expect from it. But alas -- there are far many more for me to experiment with for now.. so I bid adieu.

I use this for everything. Weekly on my face. Spot treatment on zits. Keeps things clear after wearing tight leggings working out. Keeps my feet soft. Even use it on a bandaid for a wart! It’s a staple!

False advertising. This is just regular toner. It is a thin, watery liquid, not gel-like at all and does NOT exfoliate dead skin as demonstrated in all the ads. Absolutely disappointing. Zero stars really. Don't be duped like me. *Insert eyeroll here* Fortunately I found something else that works like it's supposed to.
I am using the product a week ago and the results is notably my skin feels more hidrate I like so far

I like the feel and effects of this product. It is unscented or if not, very lightly scented and it didn't cause any skin irritation on me. It goes on easily, dries quickly and it doesn't feel sticky. After cleansing I applied it to a cotton pad and swiped it all over my face and neck except my eye area. I appreciated how it removed some remaining dirt and oils which was evident because the cotton pad was no longer completely white, and the product itself is clear. My skin felt clean but not tight or stripped. I took off 1 star because whenever a company claims to sell a product manufactured in the USA I do some research. The address on the box appears to not be a manufacturing plant. The building has a mailing company along with a virtual address company. When I fear a company is not being truthful on where a product is being made, I also fear the legitimacy of the product's quality and ingredients as well. I can't be sure this is the case with this product so I only took off the 1 star and would be happy to find out it is truly made in Wyoming.

avis.titre: Must-Have for Oily and Acne-Prone Skin
avis.texte: This toner is an essential part of my skincare treatment room and one that I always keep in stock. It works especially well for oily and acne-prone skin, helping to leave the skin feeling fresh, balanced, and clean. I’ve seen consistently great results, including a healthier-looking complexion and improved skin texture. It’s gentle, effective, and a product I confidently recommend to my clients. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: Deja la piel suave y luminosa
avis.texte: Me gustó mucho este tónico. Se siente suave sobre la piel, ayuda a mejorar la textura y deja el rostro con una sensación de frescura y limpieza. Con el uso constante he notado mi piel más lisa y con un aspecto más saludable. Lo recomiendo.

avis.titre: Well-Rounded Ingredients but Lacks Exfoliating Power
avis.texte: I recently tried the MAREE Exfoliating Toner with Salicylic Acid, and unfortunately, it didn't work as well as I had hoped. Given that it’s marketed as an exfoliant, I expected it to be a bit more effective in addressing my oily skin and breakouts. While I appreciate that the toner is very gentle, it may be too gentle for my needs. It seems like it would be better suited for those with more sensitive skin rather than someone looking for a stronger exfoliating effect. I didn't see the improvements I was hoping for in terms of smoothing my skin or unclogging pores. That said, the ingredients are good, and the formulation suggests a well-rounded approach, targeting hydration, exfoliation, soothing, and protection. This makes it a potentially effective choice for many skin types. If you have sensitive skin and are looking for a mild exfoliant, this might be a good option.

avis.titre: Excellent toner, made in the US
avis.texte: This is my third product from MAREE and it is the same high quality that I have come to expect. This is a 10% acid toner, with 4 different acids, glycolic, salicylic, latic, and mandelic. I like the combination, especially the glycolic and salicylic. My main concerns are sebaceous filaments and acne, so it is a good combo of exfoliants. My skin looks clearer and has less redness since I've been using it. I find it soothing, and like that there is both hyaluronic acid and centella extract. HA helps prevent any dryness, and the centella is nice and soothing which is great when using chemical exfoliants. Light scent Non-sticky, non drying. Leaves my skin refreshed and ready for toner. Made in the US, but comparable quality to K-Beauty brands Price (at ~ 19$ which it has stayed at for the vast majority of the listing history) is quite good. The packaging is also nice, so it looks good on your counter Would highly recommend!

I tried to wait until I was at least a month in before reviewing, but I haven’t notice any key difference with my skin texture. Maybe I picked the wrong one? However it’s giving more of a makeup remover than a toner. Product is very light, no smells, no burning.

avis.titre: Easy to apply and works well
avis.texte: This exfoliating toner is a straightforward and effective product for anyone looking to tackle clogged pores and uneven skin texture. The formula, which combines salicylic acid (BHA) with AHAs, works to gently dissolve dead skin cells, excess oil, and other impurities that can lead to breakouts. I found it to be particularly useful for keeping blackheads and congestion around the nose and chin under control. The liquid has a lightweight, watery consistency that absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky or heavy residue. It did not cause any significant irritation on my combination skin, though it has a slight tingling sensation upon application which is normal for this type of active product. After several weeks of use, my skin appeared smoother and more refined, with noticeably fewer bumps and a more even tone. The packaging is functional with a screw top lid, though pouring a small amount directly from the bottle can be a bit tricky; using a cotton pad is recommended for easier application. The value for the amount of product you receive is good, especially considering the quality of the ingredients. For those seeking a reliable chemical exfoliant to incorporate into their weekly routine, this is a solid choice. It is effective yet gentle enough for most skin types when used as directed. Just remember to follow up with a good moisturizer and, most importantly, sunscreen the next day, as AHAs can increase sun sensitivity.

avis.titre: Lightweight, layers well, but very thin
avis.texte: This toner is impressively lightweight—so much so that it feels almost like water. If you're used to thicker exfoliants, the texture might be surprising at first. That said, it absorbs quickly and layers well with other skincare products. The blend of AHA and BHA acids seems to gently refine my skin without causing irritation, and I’ve noticed a subtle improvement in texture and clarity. It’s a great option for those who want a gentle exfoliating step without any heaviness. Just be careful when pouring—it comes out fast!

avis.titre: Easy to use and nice consistency
avis.texte: This MAREE Exfoliating Toner with Salicylic Acid was easy to use and for me I did not notice any scent which was an added bonus. The toner absorbed well into my skin, was thin in consistency and my skin felt much cleaner after use.

I didn’t see any noticeable results after a few nights of trying this toner. It’s very thin and water like with no scent, which I don’t mind. It seems very mild and didn’t cause any skin irritations. To be honest, I thought this was a Korean product but now I see that it says “K beauty inspired” on the description. I also want to mention that the label seems a little deceiving because it says made in the PRC which is China. But they also added their US address right after that so if you don’t read carefully, you’d think it’s made in the US.

I quite like this toner. I have super sensitive skin and this has had no ill effects. It has absolutely no sting on any level. It has absolutely no smell either, which I like. I use my fingertips to apply to my face and chest and let it sit around for 5 or so minutes. It sinks into the skin completely and there's no tackiness or feeling after it sinks in. The bottle is pretty big and this should last a year, applying with fingertips.

I’ve been using the MAREE Exfoliating Toner with Salicylic Acid, and so far, I’m really impressed. It didn’t cause any irritation or sensitivity, which is rare for exfoliating products. After using it, my face felt refreshed, smooth, and clean, and it even has a light, fresh scent that makes it pleasant to use. I’m planning to continue using it to see the longer-term results, but so far, it’s been a great addition to my skincare routine. Perfect for gentle but effective exfoliation!

According to my wife this product is odorless, which she loves: it only has active ingredients, no perfumes. This toner leaves the skin clean and refreshed without making it dry. I feels like it cleans deep and allows for your pores to better absorb products applied to your skin afterwords.

This exfoliator is about as thin as water. It’s not thicker with the consistency of soap like any I’ve used before. It’s meant to be applied with cotton balls but it’s hard to feel if it’s even working. Also I want to point out that it has alpha and beta hydroxy which can increase sensitivity to sun exposure and increase likelihood of being sunburned. That alone makes it not worth it to me

Since, I'm in my 60's I have mature skin but it's also quite sensitive so I'm always very hesitant about what products I use on my face. Because of this, toner isn't something I've been using because it sometimes burns my face. My skin hasn't been looking great lately so I decided to try this product. I was very pleased to find this product doesn't have a harsh smell and it's not perfumed like a lot of other products. I can detect a slight smell when sniffing the top of the bottle but not much. When I used it on my face, I couldn't smell the product at all. The product is very easy to use by applying with a cotton ball or fingertips. I opted for a cotton ball. The toner dried quickly and afterwards, I applied my regular serums and moisturizers. I did not have any burning sensation after application of the product & my skin hasn't shown the tell-tale redness that I get from product sensitivity. Overall, I'm very pleased with this product even though I've only been using it for a short time. I love that this product is an American product, not tested on animals & that it's fragrance free.

avis.titre: Works Well, I Love This Brand
avis.texte: After using this for several weeks now, I am very pleased with the results. This toner gently exfoliates my face without causing irritation. There is no smell or stinging sensation when I dab it on with a cotton pad around my face. I have tried this brand out using several of their other products, and I can say I am a fan. I have yet to try anything that is poor quality or that causes my face to break out. This exfoliating toner also comes in a really good size that will last me quite awhile. Try it!

I was skeptical at first, but the MAREE Exfoliating Toner really lives up to the hype. It’s helped control my oily T-zone and minimized the appearance of pores. My skin feels cleaner and looks more radiant after every use. It’s unscented, lightweight, and non-sticky formula gives that fresh, post-facial glow without any redness. I use it 3-4 times a week at night, and I’ve already noticed fewer breakouts. Highly recommend if you want a toner that gently resurfaces skin while keeping acne and dullness under control.

I Iove this facial toner! The texture is super lightweight, almost like water so it absorbs fast without leaving any sticky or heavy feeling. I use it at night after cleansing, and by the next morning my skin feels smoother and looks a little more glowy. After a couple weeks, I noticed my pores around the nose and chin look less noticeable, and my makeup goes on more evenly. What I really like is that it’s exfoliating but not harsh. I didn’t experience any stinging or dryness like I’ve had with other acids. The hyaluronic acid adds just enough hydration so my skin feels refreshed instead of stripped. If you want a toner that helps with texture, dullness, or pores but still feels gentle enough for regular use, this one’s an affordable winner. Definitely keeping it in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: evening time toner for anti age support
avis.texte: great anti age support exfoliating toner. Maree did a good job with the bright green color of the bottle to the unscented version of a toner that is working well and effective at helping to get the dry skin off my face. The bottle is large making this a good value to ratio. The quality of ingredients seem good. The bottle reminds you to be careful to sun exposure while using these acids. This is very easy to use. pat it onto a clean face and let it sit and absorb. It says better for evening time use of you use it during the day you need to apply a sunscreen.

avis.auteur: Just A Girl That Loves Her Dogs
avis.texte: I am very impressed with this exfoliating toner. Before this purchase, I was unaware that toner could also serve as an exfoliator. This toner contains glycolic, lactic, mandelic, and salicylic acid. The glycolic acid breaks down the gunk holding down your skin cells, the lactic acid helps with exfoliation and provides some moisturization, the mandelic acid promotes cell turnover, leading to a smoother texture, reducing fine lines, and a brighter, more even complexion, and the salicylic acid cleanses pores by dissolving oils and buildup. This is some excellent stuff. I am very, very pleased with the results. I had a patch of dry skin that I could not get rid of, no matter what I tried. After using this for two weeks, it is almost completely gone. My husband has even started using it. I can not praise it enough.

avis.titre: Great toner! Safe for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I really like this toner! I have very sensitive skin, and this product did NOT cause any kind of reaction whatsoever. It’s unscented too. It is not overly drying like a lot of toners can be. Leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean. It’s done a good job keeping my acne under control as well! Highly recommend! I’ve tried a few products from this brand now, and have yet to be disappointed!
